videos.title: Fireworks
videos.overview: Asmani and Manas meet at a pub, and an unexpected kiss sparks a new connection.

videos.title: Shayad Yahi Hai
videos.overview: After a one-night encounter, Asmani and Manas reunite unexpectedly at college.

videos.title: Shuru Se Shuru
videos.overview: An unexpected moment of care brings Asmani and Manas closer, prompting a fresh start.

videos.title: Beaches and Mountains
videos.overview: Asmani earns her coach's approval, while Manas misses their beach date after a fight.

videos.title: Off Schedule
videos.overview: Asmani learns selectors will watch her match, then discovers that her monthly cycle is late.

videos.title: Mood Swings
videos.overview: Guilty over her Dad's sacrifices and fearing for her dreams, Asmani reveals her pregnancy to Manas.

videos.title: Truth Bomb
videos.overview: After a positive test, Asmani and Manas decide to return to Mumbai and end the pregnancy.

videos.title: Heads Ya Tails?
videos.overview: A clinic raid interrupts Asmani and Manas's attempt to terminate the pregnancy.

videos.title: The Deed is Done
videos.overview: Manas reconnects with his mother and faces emotional struggles. Asmani goes ahead with the abortion.
